customManagers.description: Hardcoded k8s Job/CronJob images + app values image lines

CNPG Cluster imageName (Postgres images). Digest changes on already-pinned strings replace in place; pinDigest is intentionally off for this manager (see the helm-values-only pinDigests packageRule) because CNPG pins an immutable CRD variable.

Split repo:/tag: pairs — currently no pairs exist in the repo (the Tailscale DNSConfig CronJob was replaced by the static coredns-custom ConfigMap). Retained solely for parity with discover-images.sh source-grep pair detection, so the two mechanisms can never drift. Inline image: lines belong to Manager 1 — this manager intentionally has no inline matcher so a dep can never be extracted twice. Inline maps (`image: { repository: ..., tag: ... }` in nextcloud/immich values) are owned by Renovate's built-in helm-values manager — adding a regex manager for them double-extracts the same dep and breaks branch creation (seen as 'Error updating branch: update failure' on the library/nextcloud digest branch). Patterns must stay RE2-compatible: no lookahead, no backreferences (Renovate uses RE2).

packageRules.description: Automerge patch+minor to dev (human promotes dev -> main after CI green)
Postgres images restart the DB pods on every tag/digest bump — never automerge (human review required, majors never automerge anyway)
Never use a release less than 1 day old - global setting already enforces this, except pinDigest

Digest and pinDigest updates retarget refs that already aged under the tag update (docker hub often 403s paginated /tags, leaving no releaseTimestamp); without this, minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-required holds them forever and the same-update branch re-emits as an error (update library/nextcloud docker digest)

Pin digests only on helm-values surfaces (inline image maps accept in-tag digests and its native autoReplaceStringTemplate appends @sha256:). Custom regex managers cannot: their deps go through the generic doAutoReplace which never appends a missing digest (currentDigest absent => no substitution), so confirmIfDepUpdated always fails ('Digest is not updated') and the whole pin branch errors as update failure.
Images/charts without digest support - tags only (helmv3 OCI group, charts cannot pin digests)
kubectl - group the 6 jobs, pin digest
Group Helm charts (vault, longhorn and cert-manager included — proven stable)
